model_contract_scope.scope_text: G1 and the SARAH-attested model contract attest a truncation (g1_contract_truncation_scope_v20, G1_CONTRACT_TRUNCATION_SCOPE_V20.json): the declared Lagrangian keeps 10 of the 26 renormalizable fermion bilinears allowed by SO(10) x U(1)_X x Z17 (Z17 = X mod 17 for every field, so Z17 adds no condition). The 16 omitted couplings in the model file's field basis (Delta126bar.F.P, Delta126bar.F.R, Delta126bar.P.P, Delta126bar.P.R, Delta126bar.R.R, H10.P.P, H10.P.R, H10.R.R, Phi17.F.Rbar, Phi17.P.Rbar, conj[Delta126bar].Pbar.Rbar, conj[H10].Pbar.Rbar, conj[Phi17].F.Pbar, conj[Phi17].R.Pbar, conj[S].P.Qbar, conj[S].R.Qbar) each involve P, R, Pbar, Rbar or Qbar of the vectorlike sector (Phi17.F.Rbar and conj[Phi17].F.Pbar are F-Rbar and F-Pbar mass mixings) and are PQ neutral. EXACT: the declared terms and all 26 couplings plus the scalar links have the same 3-dimensional U(1) kernel (X, PQ, spectator number), F, P and R carry identical charges, and each omitted charge vector is an integer combination of declared ones, so no U(1) and no multiplet-diagonal phase symmetry of the declared Lagrangian protects the truncation. EXACT: the 16-label list depends on the field basis because F, P and R are charge-degenerate, but no field basis removes the truncation: the omitted couplings span 48 real generation-expanded dimensions, more than the 25 of U(5) on the five X = 1 sixteens, the only linear, kinetic-term-preserving field redefinition that mixes distinct multiplets. ARGUMENT, not computed: the truncation is therefore not expected to be stable under renormalisation. At the dimension-4 level the committed G8 analysis already includes all 26 couplings. The couplings are not added (that would be a new contract).

EXACT: every vacuum of the degree-2-SOS-certified witness family is flavour-dead at the dimension-4 level (M_e = phase x M_d^T, CKM = 1 at tan beta = 1; g8_sm_pati_salam_structural_obstruction_v20). EXACT relations, NUM data comparison: on the witness branch the renormalizable Yukawas give CKM = 1, m_t = m_b and m_d = m_e, which the tan-beta-independent tests exclude (G8 Route C; g8_sm_pati_salam_flavour_nogo_v20). Research-recorded, not a committed certificate: no certification method has been demonstrated for the flavour-capable vacuum orientations (degree-2 SOS leaves flat Phi-sector directions at the G3221/G3211 orientations; rescue-study NUM, Phi sector only). NUM: G6 is not closable on the SOS-certified witness family at one loop with tree-level matching (sampled region; only the tree-matching statement is robust; g6_sm_pati_salam_remnant_rg_nogo_v20); on the decoupled-singlet benchmark BM-DA1 (U1 root held fixed; gauge + matter running) a 120_H, a second 126bar and vectorlike pairs (also with a 45_H) fail the reduced-Planck Landau criterion already at two loops, and the other analysed additions (10_F, a real or complex 45_H) pass at two loops and fail at three loops, as does the contract content itself on that root (three-loop verdict convention- and threshold-limited; omitted Yukawa terms not conservative for a fail statement; g7_decoupled_singlet_benchmark_evidence_v20). The attested contract is a truncation (g1_contract_truncation_scope_v20). Gate statuses are unchanged (G1-G5 CLOSED, G6 OPEN, G7 BLOCKED, G8 BLOCKED); this is not a proof-grade exclusion of the SO(10) x U(1)_X contract, and the whole model is neither validated nor excluded by any gate.

verdict: WITHHOLD APPROVAL. The audit has no execution failure and the gauged-U(1)_X model contract is attested by bound external SARAH execution evidence; G1, G2, G3 (SM Pati-Salam benchmark family, scoped), G4 (at the G3 witness benchmark, tree level) and G5 are closed, which meets decision D3, but decision D-E holds approval of the internal-candidate tier until G7 is CLOSED, and decision U3 never approves it. By decision U3 the internal candidate is released: certified tree-level vacuum, excluded by G8 flavour at 8.9 sigma (minimum load-bearing pull 8.86 sigma with a 10% theory term, 13.24 sigma on experimental errors alone; witness-branch renormalizable Yukawas, tan-beta-independent tests, 1e9-2e16 GeV), not approved (CKM = 1, m_t = m_b, m_d = m_e; G8_SM_PATI_SALAM_FLAVOUR_NOGO_V20.json). The G6-G8 scientific gates remain open or blocked (sub-M_I coloured states, positivity beyond tree level and electroweak symmetry breaking, RG-anchor content and the Higgs quartic, Yukawas and proton decay). No internal-candidate, conditional-benchmark, full-phenomenology, empirical-realization, or whole-model-exclusion claim is approved; the whole model is neither validated nor excluded by a proof-grade certificate. Program verdict (decision U1): NOT VIABLE as a complete description of nature under the declared standards; the no-go is method-limited at G3 x G8.
